$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-X01.job: Privacy: open, edit and export in every app.
RJ-X01.outcome: No socket opens (lsof shows none); the only network use is Check for Updates, and only when allowed.
RJ-X01.needs_note: none: a network lint and a socket probe are not in the plan
RJ-X01.trap: Blueprint updater checks daily by default; a URLSession call slips into a model

RJ-X02.job: Privacy: Photo File > Export with no metadata strips GPS, serial, MakerNote and IPTC; orientation stays right.
RJ-X02.outcome: The exported JPEG has no GPS, BodySerialNumber, MakerNote or IPTC tags, and its pixels are upright.
RJ-X02.trap: No test holds it; a 'keep' option built on CGImageDestinationAddImageFromSource would copy everything

RJ-X03.job: Privacy: Library export with location off leaves no GPS in the JPEG, the HEIC or the XMP sidecar.
RJ-X03.outcome: No GPS tags in the exported JPEG, the HEIC or the XMP sidecar.
RJ-X03.trap: Sidecar carries xmp:CreateDate and GPS beside a clean file

RJ-X04.job: Privacy: Halo movies, Flare and Design rasters carry no user name, path or host in their metadata.
RJ-X04.outcome: No user name, home path or host name in any metadata of the movies or rasters.
RJ-X04.trap: AVAsset or PNG text chunks pick up a path; untested

RJ-X05.job: Privacy: copying out of Photo puts no source metadata on the pasteboard.
RJ-X05.outcome: The pasteboard image carries no GPS, serial or MakerNote.
RJ-X05.trap: Re-encode via AddImageFromSource from the original would carry GPS

RJ-X06.job: Privacy: saved documents (.ora, .design, .flare, .halo, catalog) hold no absolute paths beyond linked files the person placed.
RJ-X06.outcome: A grep of every saved document finds no $HOME path except the paths of files the person linked.
RJ-X06.trap: Linked placement and recents store home-folder paths; unverified

RJ-X07.job: Privacy: after export, close and quit, no copy of the image is left in temp, caches or a recovery folder.
RJ-X07.outcome: Temp, caches and the recovery folder hold no copy of the image after quit.
RJ-X07.trap: Recovery folders exist by design; cleanup after save is unverified

RJ-X08.job: Security: the app writes only where the person chose and inside its own Application Support.
RJ-X08.outcome: Every file the app writes is in the chosen folder or its own Application Support; a '..' in a name template never leaves the folder.
RJ-X08.needs_note: none (v1 is not sandboxed, suite blueprint)
RJ-X08.trap: A writer resolves '..' in a name template

RJ-X09.job: Install: download the beta, drag to Applications, double-click.
RJ-X09.outcome: It opens without a Gatekeeper block.
RJ-X09.needs_note: none: notarized Developer ID is 'Out' of v1 in the suite blueprint
RJ-X09.trap: Ad-hoc signed bundle is blocked on first open

RJ-X10.job: Update: with no internet, Check for Updates fails quietly and every app keeps working.
RJ-X10.outcome: Offline, Check for Updates fails without a dialog at launch, and every app opens, edits and saves.
RJ-X10.trap: Error dialog on every launch offline

RJ-X11.job: Fidelity: a Photo .ora opens in another OpenRaster editor with its layers.
RJ-X11.outcome: Another OpenRaster editor opens the .ora with the same layers, names and order.
RJ-X11.trap: Masks only in Photo's private folder; untested elsewhere

RJ-X12.job: Fidelity: a PSD test matrix (groups, masks, text, adjustments, 16-bit) opens with a named list of anything dropped.
RJ-X12.outcome: Each matrix file opens, and anything dropped is named in a list before the person goes on.

RJ-X13.job: Fidelity: an SVG exported from Design re-opens in Design, Flare and Halo within 1% pixel difference.
RJ-X13.outcome: The SVG re-opened in Design, Flare and Halo is within 1% pixel difference of the original.
RJ-X13.trap: Text, gradients or shadows lost on the way back

RJ-X14.job: Fidelity: copy vectors in Design and paste into Flare or Halo as editable shapes.
RJ-X14.outcome: The paste arrives as editable vector shapes with the same colours, not a bitmap.

RJ-X15.job: Fidelity: open a JPEG and export it unchanged at quality 90.

RJ-X16.job: Fidelity: an upright portrait phone photo is upright in every app and in every export.
RJ-X16.outcome: Every app shows the portrait upright, and every export is upright with or without metadata.
RJ-X16.trap: Stripping metadata drops the orientation tag on a raw copy

RJ-X17.job: Large: an 8K (7680×4320) photo opens under 3 s, brush p95 under 16 ms, exports under 5 s.
RJ-X17.outcome: Open under 3 s, brush p95 under 16 ms, export under 5 s.

RJ-X18.job: Large: a 100 MP photo opens, crops and exports with memory under budget.
RJ-X18.outcome: The 100 MP photo opens, crops and exports with peak memory under the gate's budget.

RJ-X19.job: Large: 200 brush strokes on an 8K canvas keep memory flat (undo stores tiles).
RJ-X19.outcome: Memory after 200 strokes is within the gate's budget of memory after the first.

RJ-X20.job: Access: do the Instagram crop (RJ-P01) with VoiceOver only.
RJ-X20.outcome: Every control is announced with a name.

RJ-X21.job: Access: do one core job per app with the keyboard only.
RJ-X21.outcome: Each app's core job finishes with no mouse event.
RJ-X21.needs_note: none (a keyboard path is claimed, not job-tested)
RJ-X21.trap: A canvas tool reachable only by mouse

RJ-X22.job: Access: Reduce Motion and Increase Contrast are respected in the chrome.
RJ-X22.outcome: With Reduce Motion on, the chrome doesn't animate; with Increase Contrast on, it draws its higher-contrast look.

RJ-X23.job: Access: flags and labels never rely on colour alone.
RJ-X23.outcome: Every flag and label shows a shape or text as well as its colour.
RJ-X23.trap: Colour dots with no shape or text

RJ-X24.job: Crash: kill -9 each app mid-edit; relaunch restores within one autosave interval.
RJ-X24.outcome: Each app relaunches with an offer to restore that loses no more than one autosave interval.
RJ-X24.trap: Design, Halo and Library lose work today

RJ-X25.job: Undo: save, undo five steps, redo; the file and the canvas agree.
RJ-X25.outcome: After save, undo 5, redo 5, the canvas matches the saved file.

RJ-X26.job: Crash: a full disk while saving keeps the original intact and says why.
RJ-X26.outcome: The original file is byte-for-byte intact and the error names the full disk.
RJ-X26.trap: Non-atomic write truncates the file; unverified

RJ-X27.job: Crash: a truncated or corrupt file opens with a named error, no crash.
RJ-X27.outcome: Each app shows a named error for the damaged file and keeps running.

RJ-X28.job: Suite: double-click a .design, .ora, .flare or .halo in Finder; the right app opens it.
RJ-X28.outcome: Each document type opens in its own app.
RJ-X28.trap: Opens in the launcher or the wrong app

RJ-X29.job: Suite: send a Library photo to Photo and back; rating and original kept.
RJ-X29.outcome: The photo comes back with its rating, and the original file is unchanged.

RJ-X30.job: Give a shape a three-stop linear gradient at 45 degrees by commands alone, drag its middle stop with 120 moves, then undo once.
RJ-X30.outcome: The saved document holds stops at 0, 0.5 and 1 on a 45-degree line through the shape's centre, and after the drag and one undo the middle stop is back at 0.5.
RJ-X30.trap: The 120 moves land as 120 undo steps, or the angle is saved in radians

RJ-X31.job: Make 30 edits by command, jump back 10 steps in the history with one command, then make one more edit.
RJ-X31.outcome: The jump lands on step 20 without recording a step, the document is the state after edit 20, and the new edit replaces the 10 undone steps.
RJ-X31.trap: The jump records a step of its own, or the undone steps survive the new edit

RJ-X32.job: Rotate a shape 15 degrees with one 60-sample drag by commands, flip it, then undo once.
RJ-X32.outcome: The saved shape reads 15 degrees with its position unchanged after the undo of the flip, and a second undo reads 0: the drag was one step.
RJ-X32.trap: The drag lands as 60 undo steps, the turn saves in radians, or the flip moves the shape

RJ-X33.job: Read the colour under three points by command: over a red shape on top of another, in a gradient's middle, and on empty canvas.
RJ-X33.outcome: The overlap reads the top shape's red, the gradient reads its 50% mix within 1 per channel, and empty canvas reads null.
RJ-X33.trap: The sample reads the selected or lower shape

RJ-X34.job: Draw a five-point star by command, try a two-sided polygon, then undo.
RJ-X34.outcome: The star is saved with its kind, points and inner ratio; the polygon is refused with "A polygon needs 3 to 64 sides." and adds nothing; one undo removes the star.
RJ-X34.trap: An out-of-range count is silently clamped, or the star saves as a flat path

RJ-X35.job: Add a 4 pt stroke by command, make it dashed, scrub its trim end to 50% with 60 samples, then undo once.
RJ-X35.outcome: Before the undo the stroke reads dash [16, 8] and trim end 0.5; after it there is no trim: the scrub was one step.
RJ-X35.trap: The dash pattern ignores the width, or the trim saves as a percentage
